Lott Dod must have an antidote.|[[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] poisoned [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref>}}
An '''antidote''' was a form of medicine specifically designed to counteract a [[Poison/Legends|poison]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] poisoned fellow senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with [[manax-root poison]]. The [[Manax-root poison antidote|specific antidote]] for the poison was forcibly taken from Dod by [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] and administered via an injection by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

[[MD-1 medical droid]]s were programmed to develop antidotes, [[vaccine]]s, and [[Antibiotic/Legends|antibiotics]] in tandem with [[Computer/Legends|computers]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
